<a name="Frame"></a>
## type Frame

Frame is everything required to draw one screen.

```go
type Frame struct {
    Body       string
    Keys       keys.KeyMap
    Extra      []keys.Binding
    Width      int
    Height     int
    Covered    bool
    HasFooter  bool
    EnterLabel string
}
```

<a name="Item"></a>
## type Item

```go
}
```
